crossRefs.note: I will pour on David’s house, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplication; and they…
For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’ ”
But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

translations.web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
translations.bsb: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
translations.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
translations.asv: And they also, if they continue not in their unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.
